Run the local CI gate suite for a repository.

Detects the repo stack (Go, Node/TS, Flutter) and runs the appropriate
lint, test, and build checks plus a gitleaks secret scan. Posts a
"nself-ci" GitHub commit status via gh OAuth so branch protection can
require nself-ci instead of billing-blocked GitHub Actions checks.

Examples:
  nself ci                        # gate current directory, post status
  nself ci --check                # gate only, no status posted
  nself ci --no-gitleaks .        # skip secret scan
  nself ci --sha abc1234 .        # override commit SHA
  nself ci --filesystem /tmp/x    # force filesystem scan (non-checkout source, e.g. a tarball)
  nself ci /path/to/repo          # gate a specific repo

Usage:
  nself ci [repo-root] [flags]
  nself ci [command]

Available Commands:
  build       Build a signed release artifact locally (Android only)
  eval        Run eval-gate suite or validate an eval-set YAML
  forgejo     Show Forgejo server + runner health (ops profile)
  serve       Start the nself-ci webhook listener daemon (port 3845)

Flags:
      --check          Run gates only; do not post a GitHub commit status
      --filesystem     Force gitleaks filesystem scan (--no-git) even inside a git checkout; opt-in for non-checkout source trees such as an exported tarball
  -h, --help           help for ci
      --no-gitleaks    Skip the gitleaks secret scan
      --no-status      Alias for --check
      --owner string   GitHub owner (default: from git remote)
      --repo string    GitHub repo name (default: from git remote)
      --sha string     Commit SHA to report on (default: HEAD)
  -v, --verbose        Print each gate command before running

Global Flags:
      --json                      Machine-readable output: one JSON document on stdout (see JSON-Output)
      --no-deprecation-warnings   Suppress deprecation warnings (for scripted use)
      --no-monorepo               Disable automatic monorepo backend detection

Use "nself ci [command] --help" for more information about a command.
